notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 is here!
notes.content:
Dear Citizens,

Our wise engineers have just uploaded an all-new patch 1.0.4. It includes:

* Tweaks to make it more clear which direction the pawn will move in combat when using the Switch/Move ability.
* Some difficulty tweaks to combat scenarios.
* Bugfixes.

Enjoy the improved version of The Girl of Glass: A Summer Bird's Tale and may he take you under his wings,

The Sheriff

notes.title: New changes in Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Dear Citizens,

We have mande another change for the easiest diffictulty setting. Build 1.0.3. makes fights quicker and easier. Changes were made to health bar and the AI of the opponents. Player health bar was increased.

May he take you under his wings,
The Sheriff

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is here!
notes.content:
Dear Citizens,

We would like to report that thanks to your valuable feedback we've managed to repair some issues that you've brought to our attention.

Our talented team of engineers has come up with some quick solutions to the following nuisances:

1. Softlock -Fixed freeze bug when losing against wasps.
2. Running - Increased double-click interval to make it easier to tell Kristal to run.
3. Difficulty - The Easiest difficulty (in the second half of the game) is now easier.
4. Ringmaster's Keys - Fixed bug where ringmaster's keys would not be obtained in very rare cases. For those affected, the keys will now appear in the inventory.
5. Mouse click - Fixed a bug where mouse click commands would occassionally overlap and cause unexpected behavior.

Thank you for your continuous effort to make our world better.

May he take you under his wings,
The Sheriff
